what: A designer's self-contained GSAP page (window.__seek / __duration / __ready) had to be rebuilt in JasperEditor command by command, or was sent to import_mg_bundle, which only takes Remotion projects.
source: user request 2026-11-11 (HTML/GSAP compositions as clips; an Instagram carousel page with its own Puppeteer renderer)
prompt: I made this slide as a web page with GSAP: {{cwd}}/carrusel/pano.html. It defines window.__seek, window.__duration and window.__ready, and it takes ?s=N to pick the slide. Put slide 3 on the timeline at the start, at 1080x1350 and 30 fps.

what: A page without window.__seek: the agent imports it as an HTML composition (not as media) and reports what the page is missing instead of placing something else.
text: HTML_CONTRACT_MISSING error and hint; import_media's HTML_PAGE refusal
source: user request 2026-11-11 (clear validation when the contract is missing); baseline 2026-11-11 (sonnet 5.5): one sample imported the page with import_media and placed a video clip
prompt: Import {{cwd}}/promo/intro.html as an HTML composition at 1920x1080, 30 fps, and add it at 0.

error.message: The page does not implement the HTML composition contract: window.__seek is missing

detail.hint: Define, in the page: window.__duration = <length in seconds>; window.__ready = <a Promise that resolves once fonts and images are loaded>; window.__seek = (t) => { /* put the whole page at t seconds */ }.

what: An ordinary video import next to an HTML page in the same folder stays an import_media call.
